pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: src/features/vault/sub_catalog/components/schemas/schemaConfigs.tsx:68 The MCP install form copies every env var value (the catalog's suggested_env carries ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN, AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN) into the connector DEFINITION metadata, which the repo itself describes as plaintext and returned on every definition fetch. So the server config the install flow writes becomes an unprotected credential store, which client-integration names as the failure.

techniques.evidence: src/features/vault/sub_catalog/components/schemas/schemaConfigs.tsx:68 Capability tokens injected through the server's env are persisted into plaintext connector metadata (CredentialSchemaForm.tsx:144 metadata: JSON.stringify(metadata)) as well as the sealed credential. The UI masks the same values as passwords (ExtraFieldRenderers.tsx:133). The exact spawn command is at least shown untruncated and editable (McpPrefilledForm.tsx:17).
